current_evidence: The official 'Local validation list' page (https://www.southdowns.gov.uk/planning-process/apply/local-validation-list/) links only to 'SDNPA Local Validation List' = Local-Validation-List-BNG-version-2024-002.pdf and says it 'contains revised content necessary for legislative changes relating to Biodiversity Net Gain'; neither the page nor the PDF states an adoption date (the PDF's BNG triggers are dated 12 February 2024 and 2 April 2024), and the September 2023 file Grokbot used is no longer linked.

issues.detail: Grokbot links the superseded 'Local-Validation-List-September-2023.pdf'. The authority's local validation list page now links only the 'BNG version 2024-002' list, which replaces the pre-statutory BNG wording with the statutory major-site (from 12 Feb 2024) and small-site (from 2 Apr 2024) requirements. The old URL still resolves but is not the current list.
issues.evidence: Local validation list page: link text 'SDNPA Local Validation List' -> /app/uploads/2023/05/Local-Validation-List-BNG-version-2024-002.pdf; 'contains revised content necessary for legislative changes relating to Biodiversity Net Gain'

issues.detail: List date 2023-05-01 comes from the WordPress upload folder (/2023/05/), not the document. The file Grokbot read is named 'September 2023', and its text gives no date. The current list is the 2024 BNG version (its own text gives no adoption date; its BNG triggers take effect 12 Feb 2024 and 2 Apr 2024). The 'Outdated (>2y)' flag is therefore based on the wrong version.
issues.evidence: Date basis 'url path (upload month)'; current PDF: 'BNG for Major Sites ... on or after 12 February 2024'

issues.detail: The Householder row says '(none) - national requirements only', but the list applies several local requirements to householder applications: Ecosystem Services Statement (all applications except LBC, prior approvals, LDCE/LDP and adverts; a separate householder guidance note exists), CIL Forms (all householder applications), Sustainability Assessment (residential extensions adding over 100 sqm internal floor area), Tree Survey/AIA (development affecting trees unless the SDNPA checklist shows no impact), Heritage Statement, Biodiversity survey where protected species are likely, Lighting Assessment (any outdoor lighting), FRA in Flood Zones 2/3, and the local drawing standards (roof plans, site sections).
issues.evidence: Ecosystem Services Statement: 'All applications (with exception of Listed Building Consent, Prior Approvals, LDCE/LDP, Advertisement Consent)'; CIL: 'All householder, minor and major applications (including S73 applications), outline and reserved matters applications'

issues.detail: Several other application-type rows say '(none)' when local items do apply. Outline, Reserved matters and Variation of condition s73 should carry the CIL forms. Lawful development cert should also carry the CIL forms, which the current 2024 list extends to prior approvals and LDCs. Listed building consent should carry the Heritage Statement (development affecting a designated heritage asset).
issues.evidence: CIL Forms 1, 2, 5: 'All householder, minor and major applications (including S73 applications), outline and reserved matters applications'

issues.detail: All 20 Full planning rows carry 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. The source does state its scope. Some items apply to all application types (e.g. Tree Survey, HRA screening, Heritage Statement, Land contamination). Others apply only to major development (Surface Water Drainage Strategy, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Parking Assessment). Others exclude only householder (Landscape Appraisal, Noise). Putting everything under Full planning misstates both the scope and the thresholds.
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Surface Water Drainage Strategy - All applications for major development'; 'Landscape Appraisal ... All applications for development (including change of use) with the exception of householder applications'

issues.detail: Viability Assessment is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' with the note 'Application type named in requirement text'. The source does not apply viability to prior approvals. The excerpt is a reference title (BNP Paribas 2017 viability study) that runs into the Telecommunications Statement row. The actual trigger is wherever viability is relevant: under-provision of affordable housing, enabling development, optimum viable use, loss of employment/visitor uses, agricultural building conversion, rural worker dwellings.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Affordable Housing Viability Assessment (BNP Paribas 2017) (Opens PDF) ... Telecommunications Statement All telecommunications equipment app'

issues.detail: Land Contamination Assessment is placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)' with the note 'Application type named in requirement text'. SDNPA is not a county minerals/waste authority for this purpose, and the source applies the requirement to all applications where contamination is known or suspected, within 250m of a landfill, or where a sensitive use is proposed on previously used land.
issues.evidence: 'All applications if contamination is known/suspected to exist ... All applications where the site is within 250m of a current licensed or historic landfill site.'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' does not appear in the SDNPA local list. Its trigger excerpt is the Tree Survey/Arboricultural text ('All applications for development affecting trees ... Bat Conservation'), so the row is a misclassification.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt begins 'Arboricultural Assessment/Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan (in accordance with BS:5837 ...'

issues.detail: 'Self-build / custom build information' is not a requirement in the list. The excerpt is the BNG small-sites text, where 'small scale self-build and custom housebuilding' appears as a statutory BNG exemption, not as a document to submit.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Small scale self-build and custom housebuilding ... Residential development with fewer than 10 residential units on a site area less than 1 hectare'

issues.detail: The 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' and 'Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment' triggers are land-contamination text ('includes groundworks ... A sensitive land use is proposed'). The source requires a Landscape Appraisal/Relative Tranquillity/Visual Impact assessment for all development except householder, and a full LVIA only for EIA development. The EIA itself sits within the Biodiversity/EIA row.
issues.evidence: Source: 'All applications for development (including change of use) with the exception of householder applications' / '*Landscape & Visual Impact Assessment only required as part of an EIA'

issues.detail: Many triggers are reference lists or garbled cross-row text rather than the 'Types of application' column. FRA: lists guidance titles; the source requires it for all proposals in Flood Zones 2/3 (including minor and change of use), sites over 1ha in FZ1, and sites under 1ha in FZ1 with other flood risk or critical drainage. Drainage/SuDS: Building Regs Part H and HRA text; the source requires a Surface Water Drainage Strategy for all major development and a Foul sewerage assessment for major development or no mains connection. Heritage: contamination text. Parking: references; the source covers major development plus new/extended/relocated public or visitor parking. CIL: references only. Ventilation: guidance titles; the source covers Class E, sui generis and B2 uses with new extraction equipment. Nutrient Neutrality: 'These applications must...' with no location trigger; the source covers residential and overnight-accommodation/visitor uses in the Solent or Itchen catchments. Water efficiency: cut off mid-sentence.
issues.evidence: Grokbot FRA excerpt: '2 Strategic Flood Risk Assessment Report (Amec 2017) (Opens PDF) NPPF - Chapter 14 ... BS 8533-2011 Assessing'

issues.detail: The Biodiversity Net Gain trigger is cut off and describes BNG as 'forthcoming' (from the superseded list). The current list sets BNG for Major Sites from 12 Feb 2024 (10+ dwellings or housing on more than 0.5ha, 1,000 sqm or more floorspace, or a site of 1ha or more) and Small Sites from 2 Apr 2024. Both require a 10% BNG strategy and a statutory metric in macro-disabled Excel format.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: '(Subject to requirements set out in the forthcoming Biodiversity Net G'

issues.detail: Some rows duplicate one source sentence. 'Water efficiency / water usage statement' repeats the Water Neutrality Statement text, truncated. 'Planning Obligations / S106 Heads of Terms' repeats the Affordable Housing Statement trigger. 'Housing mix' uses a sentence from the Affordable Housing row instead of the separate 'Mix of Homes Statement' (all applications for housing development).
issues.evidence: Water efficiency excerpt: 'and proposed water consumption and mitigation measures proposed.'

issues.detail: Widely applicable requirements with no app_type row (some appear only as fragments in tab_items). Ecosystem Services Statement: all applications except LBC, prior approvals, LDCE/LDP, adverts. Sustainability Assessment: new residential, commercial, agricultural or community buildings, conversions, and residential extensions over 100 sqm. Biodiversity survey / Ecological Impact Assessment: development within, adjacent to or affecting priority species or designated sites. Lighting Assessment / Dark Night Skies: any outdoor lighting, non-householder development outside settlement boundaries, near listed buildings or in conservation areas, where bats are present. Soils Management Plan: any movement of top/subsoils. Noise assessment: non-householder development likely to generate noise, or noise-sensitive uses near noise sources. Foul sewerage and utilities assessment: major development or no mains drainage connection. Odour assessment: odour-generating uses including commercial kitchens.
issues.evidence: Source rows 'Ecosystem Services Statement', 'Sustainability Assessment (SD48)', 'Lighting assessment/Dark Night Skies (SD8)', 'Soils Management Plan'

issues.detail: Topic-specific requirements not captured. Aerodrome Safeguarding Statement: wind turbines; structures 45m or more above ground. Agriculture and Forestry Workers Statement: development or loss of such housing. Agriculture/Forestry Diversification Plan. Air Quality Assessment: major development increasing traffic, bio-aerosols, particulates or odour, or affecting an AQMA; B8 over 500 sqm. Marketing assessment: loss of visitor accommodation, employment land, retail units or community facilities/ACVs; removal of rural worker occupancy conditions. Needs or Site Selection Assessment: Gypsy/Traveller sites, rural exception sites, loss of community facilities, rural worker dwellings. Options Review Assessment: rural exception sites, agricultural, infrastructure, telecoms, outdoor sport buildings. Playing Field/Sports provision assessment. Retail impact assessment: over 750 sqm in market towns, over 500 sqm in larger villages, over 150 sqm outside settlements. Telecommunications Statement: telecoms equipment, excluding prior approvals. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan: all major. Construction and Strategic Traffic Management Plans: major development over 80 properties or significant commercial/tourism. Equestrian management plan: depends on scale.
issues.evidence: Source rows SD51, SD32, SD40, SD54, Appendix 3 marketing, SD29/SD39/SD42/SD44/SD46 options review, SD38 retail, SD19/SD22 transport

issues.detail: Tab_items capture only the block plan, metric scale bar and roof plan drawing standards. They miss the local drawing requirements for full existing and proposed elevations and floor plans including outbuildings, and for existing and proposed site sections with finished floor and site levels and a datum point (1:50 or 1:100) where levels change or the site slopes.
issues.evidence: Local drawing requirements: 'Existing and proposed site sections, finished floor and site levels, and a datum point (1:50 or 1:100)'

issues.detail: Six of the eight 'Submission rules' tab_items are lists of evidence documents, guidance links or fragments, not requirements. Examples: 'South Downs National Park Employment Land Review 2015 ... Policy SD7:', 'Ciria C753 (Web Link) ... surface-water-drainage-checklists.pdf', 'Telecommunications and Utilities Infrastructure ... Revised Code of Mobile Best Practice ... Draft 5'. Two 'Policy-driven' items are only 'can be found on our website here:' pointers.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'The latest SDNPA guidance on water neutrality can be found on our website here:'

issues.detail: The tab section 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)' mislabels location-specific triggers: SAC/SPA proximity (6.5km/12km, 400m/5km), Solent/Itchen nutrient catchments and the Sussex North Water Resource Zone. The CIL note 'only where council is a CIL charging authority' is unnecessary because SDNPA is a charging authority. The 'Planning page' field is only the site homepage.
issues.evidence: Planning page: 'https://www.southdowns.gov.uk'; source links 'SDNPA Community Infrastructure Levy'

summary: Grokbot read the superseded September 2023 list. The authority's validation page now links only the 2024 BNG version, and Grokbot's date comes from the upload folder rather than the document. The extraction misses about 20 requirements (notably Ecosystem Services, Sustainability, Lighting and Soils), says householder has no local requirements, and contains many garbled triggers, invented items (Schedule of works, Self-build) and wrong application-type placements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
